games.title: Gluttonography
games.description: A mysterious dog has appeared out of nowhere. It looks like it feeds on photographs of food. Interesting.

games.title: Sheep Herder
games.description: Round up sheep across the Faroese highlands in this cozy herding sim. Watch out for fog!

games.title: Wave Rider
games.description: Surf the North Atlantic waves in a fast-paced arcade game. Chain combos to beat the storm.

games.title: Puffin Post
games.description: Deliver mail across the islands as a determined puffin. A charming delivery puzzle game.

games.title: Fog of Foroyar
games.description: A survival horror set in a fog-bound Faroese village. Can you find the lighthouse before it's too late?

games.title: Chain Dance
games.description: A rhythm game inspired by the traditional Faroese chain dance. Match the beat and keep the circle going.

games.title: Grindabod
games.description: Navigate a traditional Faroese rowing boat through treacherous fjords. A test of timing and nerve.

games.title: Northern Lights
games.description: Paint the sky with northern lights in this relaxing generative art toy. No goals, just beauty.

games.title: Turf House Builder
games.description: Build and maintain a traditional Faroese turf-roofed house. A cozy management game.

games.title: Raven Flight
games.description: Soar over the Faroe Islands as Odin's raven. An exploration game with hand-painted landscapes.
